basic_info.main_problem: Whenever I have to go somewhere new, I worry about where to park; this makes me feel inferior and engage in self-criticism, and it has developed to the point of avoiding going to new places or activities.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to get rid of the persistent worry about parking, to be able to enjoy new experiences, and to reduce the distress this causes.
growth_experiences: 早年经历父母去世，由兄长抚养长大；兄长以往给予支持，但来访者习惯独自承担问题、not yet就当前困扰与其沟通。

core_beliefs: 我without法胜任和应对新的情境

exception_events.target_problem: When preparing to go to an unfamiliar place, the client usually develops strong worry about parking and tends to avoid, leading to cancelled outings or high distress.

exception_events.reason: 线索：情境not同（当时停车位较充足/交通较缓）；因此这几次担忧not yet被Reinforcement，出现了较顺利的结果。
